data_fields.name: cast_time_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: DB CastTime per skill level (example 400 ms)

data_fields.name: fixed_cast_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: DB FixedCastTime (example 100 ms); absent = 20 percent of CastTime (renewal default)

data_fields.name: cancel_exempt_outside_gvg
data_fields.donor_constant: no-cancel status exempt except GvG and battleground maps

best_idea: A cast has a fixed windup that stats cannot remove plus a variable part that they can shorten, any landed hit cancels a cancellable cast, and a cancelled caster is free at once.
decision_why: Keep the fixed-plus-variable windup, the per-spell cancellable flag and the cancel-frees-caster rule; drop the pre-renewal linear cut and the duplicate build; take numbers from data and tune shorter than the donor example for a fast phone duel (proposed, not measured).
acceptance: A server test: a 300 ms cast with a 50 ms fixed part is cancelled by one landed hit and the cast bar clears on the same tick; a spell marked not cancellable completes through a hit; after a cancel the caster can act again on the next tick; a higher speed stat gives a shorter cast than the base value.
